_comment: P2-108 (UIPOSES lane, 1 Nov 2026). GPU item score 28 Oct 4.97: the mounted Aquaryn stands upright on the water in an identical pose with no splash and a long hard shadow on the water, reading as walking on glass. When enabled, a listed mount swimming with a rider sits extra_sink_m deeper (its 5 m body was 4 m above the surface; the seated rider stays above sea level), bobs bob_amplitude_m over bob_period_s, and casts no shadow on the water (scripts/world/water_mount_presentation.gd via water_mounted_swim.gd). Presentation of the existing swim follow only; no stamina, collision, network or save change. OFF until GPU judging.

deep_swim_1113._candidate: LANE-BELOW6 (13 Nov 2026), F39#8 (GPU High 5.82; G-rescore-stale-ext-tidewake 3/3: 'the mount still stands on top of the surface' with no immersion). The sink was capped at 1.0 m by a lane pin that the rider's art origin stays above sea level. Coordinator, 13 Nov: that pin was a lane's working rule; a rider waist-deep on a swimming mount is the believable look. Candidate: sink 1.6 m. At the deepest bob the rider's chest stays above the sea and the seat is under it. Checked that nothing in gameplay keys off the rider's height here: the trainer's swim state is forced to MOUNTED by water_mounted_swim.gd and is already inside the entry band at 1.0; the water contact rings draw only in HUMAN mode; there is no camera underwater check; the networked seat (mount_offset) is unchanged. Presentation only.
